why: Yak-38 / Yak-38M windscreen: a framed windscreen with ONE flat, steeply raked armoured front pane and a flat quarter pane each side of it (two slim posts between them), in front of one blown (curved) canopy hinged on the right (Yak-36 / Yak-38 descriptions, kit reviews; no dimensioned drawing and no clear photo of the glazing were found, so the three-flat-panes layout is the model's own line: see canopy_yak_38m.py). Only the windscreen panes are flat; the canopy shell is curved and is not listed. The front pane is the trapezoid in the plane y = YC0 - SLOPE (z - ZF) between the posts' inner edges (|x| <= 0.17, z from 3.096 to 3.736); each quarter pane is one triangle (arch corner, arch foot, base corner), so planar by construction, with |x| from 0.15 to 0.34 and z from 3.096; the sight's glass lies at z < 3.0, the shell ends at z 3.051.
